name: Capacity-Safe Marching Cubes Pipeline
definition: A GPU-based isosurface extraction method that avoids buffer overflow by determining the exact vertex count before geometry generation, using a two-pass approach: first computing counts/offsets, then allocating exact buffers and generating triangles.
summary: The Capacity-Safe Marching Cubes Pipeline is a GPU-based isosurface extraction method that prevents buffer overflow by using a two-pass approach to determine exact vertex counts before allocating precisely sized buffers.
